paite: Huai khit in Samuel in sathau bawm lakhia in alu ah asung a, atawp a, "TOUPA'N agoutante tung a heutu ding a sathau hon nilh ahi kei maw?
heading: Saul Thaunilhna

paite: Tuni a na hon nutsiat chiang in Zelzah ah Benjamin gamgi a Rakil han kiang ah mi nih na mu dia; amau na kiang ah, 'Na sabiltung zonte amuta uh. Ngai in, na pa'n sabiltungte lungkhampih nawn lou in, nang hon lungkhampihta hi. Ka tapa a ding in bang ka hih dia, chichi ahi, achi ding uh'.

Huai a pan pai zel inla, Tabor tosaw na va tung ding a, huai ah mi thum Bethel a Pathian kiang a hohtou dingte'n hon na kituahpih ding uh. Khat in kelnou apom dia, khat in tanghou pek khal thum atawi dia, khat in uain thawl atawi ding hi.
"Chibai ahon buk ding ua, tanghou pek khal nih ahon pe ding ua; huai na la ding ahi.

Huai khit in Philistia sepaihte omna Pathian mual na va tung ding ahi. Huan hichi ahi ding a, huai khua na va tun chiang in zawlnei pawl khat ama ua pekgingte, khuangtate, tamngaite leh kaihgingte tawimi pawl toh mun sang a pan hong paikhesuk na tuak dia, amaute'n thu agen ding uhi.
Na tung ah TOUPA Kha nakpitak in ahong tung ding a, nang leng amau toh thu na gen dia, huchi in mituam na suak ding hi.
" 'Hiai chiamtehnate na tung a ahong tun chiang in, thil hong om in azil dungzui in na hih ding ahi. Pathian lah na kiang ah a-om ngal a.

Kei ma in Gilgal ah hohsuk in. Ngai in, kei leng halmang thillatte leh lemna kithoihnate lan ding in na kiang ah ka hong suk ding.' Na kiang a ka hong a, na hih ding ka hon hilh ma ni sagih na taam ding," achi hi.
Huchibang ahong hi ngei a, Samuel paisan dia anungngattak in Pathian in lungtang dang apeta hi. Huai chiamtehna tengteng huai ni in ahong tung vek hi.
Huchi in mual ahong tun uleh, ngai in, zawlneite'n ana kituahpih uhi. Atung ah TOUPA Kha nakpitak in ahong tung a, athugenna uah amah leng atel samta hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, tuma lam a amah ana theisate'n zawlneite thugenna ah atel sam chih atheih un, akihou ua, "Kish tapa tung a thil hong om bangchidan ahita a? Saul leng zawlneite lak a tel samta ahi maw?" akichi uhi.
A-omna khua ua mi khat in adawng a, "Apa uh kua ahi tuan a ahia?" achi hi. Huchi in Saul leng zawlnei ahi samta maw? chih paunak ahong hita hi.
Athugen khit in mun sang atungta hi.
Saul paneu in akiang ah leh asikha kiang ah, "Koi a hoh na hi ua?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Sabiltung zong ka hi uh. Ka muh zoh louh ziak un Samuel kiang ah ka va hoh uhi," achi hi.
Saul paneu in, "Samuel in na kiang ua bang ahia agen hon hilh dih," achi hi.
Saul in apaneu kiang ah, "Sabengtungte amuta uh chih ahon hilh hi,” achi hi. Himahleh lalgam thu Samuel in agen pen ahilh kei hi.
Huchi in Samuel in mipite Mizpah ah TOUPA mai ah asamkhawm hi.
heading: Saul Kumpipa A Puan Ahi

paite: Huai ah Israel suante kiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Israelte Aigupta a pan ka pikhia a, Aigupta mite khut a pan leh nou hon nuaisiah gam tengteng a pan ka hon hunkhia hi.

Himahleh tuni in na mangbatna tengteng uleh na gimthuakna tengteng ua kipan nou hon humbitpa na Pathian uh na deih kei uh. Akiang ah, 'Ahi kei, kumpipa hon bawlsak in,' na chi uh. Huaiziak in tu in anam a nam leh achi a chỉ in TOUPA ma ah hong kilang un" achi hi.
Huchi a Samuel in Israel chi tengteng ahong kilat naisaktak in Benjamin chitel ahong hita.
Benjamin chite bel a-inkuankuan in ahong kilak ua, Matri mite inkuan tel ahong hi a, Kish tapa Saul tel ahong hita hi. Amah azon uleh amuzou kei uh.
Huaiziak in TOUPA adong tuan nawn ua, "Hiai mi hong pai nai lou hiam," achi uh. TOUPA'N adawng a, "Ngai un, van lak ah akibu hi," achi hi.
Huchi in atai ua, ava pikhia ua, mipi lak a adinleh mi lak ah asangpen a, kuamah aliangzang khengzou a-om kei uhi.
Samuel in mi tengteng kiang ah, "TOUPA miseh na mu uhia? Mi tengteng lak ah amah bang mahmah a-om kei," achi hi. Mite akikou ua, "Pathian in kumpipa hondam hen," achi uhi.
Huchi in Samuel in mipite lalgam omdan ding ahilh hi. Laibu ah agelh a, TOUPA ma ah akoih hi. Samuel in mite amau inn chiat ah apaisakta hi.
Saul leng Gibeah a a-inn ah apai sam hi. Pathian in alungtang uh akhoih mihangsante leng amah toh apaikhawm uhi.
Himahleh Belial tapate'n, "Hiai mi'n bangchi in ahon hondam thei mahmah dia?" chi in amah angaineu ua, thilpiak ahong pe kei uh. Himahleh amah bel adai dide hi.
